sources.snippet: Experiments on diverse chemical benchmarks demonstrate that ChemDFM-R achieves cutting-edge performance while providing interpretable, rationale-driven outputs. Further case studies illustrate how explicit reasoning chains significantly improve the model's reliability, transparency, and practicality in real-world human-AI collaboration scenarios.

sources.title: ChemDFM: A Large Language Foundation Model for Chemistry
sources.snippet: ChemDFM is the pioneering open-sourced dialogue foundation model for Chemistry and molecular science, which is built based on LLaMa-13B. ChemDFM outperforms the open-sourced LLMs in all the typical tasks of chemistry, and even reaches comparable or higher performances to GPT-4. For more details, please refer to our paper.
